name: 🎅 [SALE] SCP Roleplay Classic
desc:
SCP Roleplay Classic takes you on the roles of different perspectives inside the Foundation (or outside!). 

Become an Employee and perform Tasks, such as filing paperwork, cleaning the floors, performing tests, or guarding, to get Rewards and Rank UP! 

Or you can become an antagonist and cause chaos by breaching as many SCP's as you can! 

And... if you want to come back to an earlier rank, you can always change your rank to an unlocked rank of your choice.

Welcome to the Foundation,
Kind Regards, 
The Site Architect.
